evidence: dpdf_features groups the ΔPDF's extrema by sign, length (half a voxel) and size (5 %) and never uses the declared symmetry (src/nebula3d/analysis/dpdf_features.py:25-28), so an orbit whose copies differ by a few per cent splits into several entries and a planted correlation falls down the list (the dev control's weaker one is entry 19 of a default 12).
proposed_fix: When the raw file declares a point group, group the extrema by it: the declared operations (closed into a group, with r ≡ −r) act on the ΔPDF's fractional coordinates as their transpose, and an image claims the nearest unclaimed extremum of its sign within one voxel, in the cell's metric; without a declaration, today's grouping, bit for bit. The limit counts groups.
